comment: Basic Training source-language strings. Every .prompt contains >=1 {bind:...} token (lint-enforced). VO lines (.ok / .hint1) never contain key or button names — bindings are remappable, so the voice says the action and the glyph names the key. <=8 functional words per VO line.
tut.bt.title: BASIC TRAINING
tut.bt.ui.skipbar: HOLD {bind:skip_step} — SKIP STEP · ESC — MENU · HOLD {bind:help} — CONTROLS
tut.bt.a0.prompt: Systems ready. Press {bind:ui_confirm} to power up.
tut.bt.a0.prompt_vo: Systems ready. Confirm to power up.
tut.bt.a2.prompt: Hold {bind:throttle_down} to slow to a stop.
tut.bt.a4.prompt: Press {bind:steer_left} and {bind:steer_right} to turn your legs.
tut.bt.a4a.prompt: The cyan arrow points where to walk. Press {bind:ui_confirm} to continue.
tut.bt.a4a.ok: Good. It always knows the way.
tut.bt.a4b.prompt: Use {bind:steer_left} / {bind:steer_right} to face the arrow, then hold {bind:throttle_up} to walk to it.
tut.bt.a4b.ok: Waypoint reached. That's the whole trick.
tut.bt.a4b.hint1: Turn until the arrow points up.
tut.bt.a5.prompt: Use {bind:throttle_up} {bind:steer_left} {bind:steer_right} — follow the arrow through the three gates.
tut.bt.a6.prompt: Press {bind:full_stop} for an instant full stop.
tut.bt.b2.prompt: Aim with {bind:torso_aim} — hold the reticle on the board.
tut.bt.b2.hint1: Hold the reticle on the board.
tut.bt.b3.prompt: Press {bind:center_torso} to snap your torso back in line.
tut.bt.b4.prompt: Hold {bind:throttle_up} toward the arrow and keep the reticle on the board while you walk.
tut.bt.b5.caption: Release to return.
tut.bt.c1.prompt: Press {bind:target_reticle} to lock the contact under your reticle.
tut.bt.c1.hint1: Lock the contact under your reticle.
tut.bt.c2.prompt: Press {bind:target_cycle} to cycle contacts. Lock all three.
tut.bt.c3.prompt: Press {bind:subtarget_cycle} to select a section of the locked contact.
tut.bt.c3.caption: No lock? Press {bind:target_reticle} first.
tut.bt.c3.hint1: Pick a section of the lock.
tut.bt.c4.prompt: This panel is your target's damage readout — each section lights as it takes hits. Press {bind:ui_confirm} to continue.
tut.bt.d1.prompt: Press {bind:group_1} to fire the autocannon at a board.
tut.bt.d1.caption: Group one: autocannon.
tut.bt.d2.caption: Group two: laser. It costs heat, not ammunition.
tut.bt.d3.prompt: Press {bind:group_3} to fire a rocket salvo.
tut.bt.d3.caption: Group three: rockets.
tut.bt.d4.prompt: Weapons free — destroy all four boards with {bind:group_1} {bind:group_2} {bind:group_3}.
tut.bt.e1.prompt: Fire {bind:group_1} {bind:group_2} {bind:group_3} until heat reaches the amber line.
tut.bt.e3.prompt: Keep firing {bind:group_1} {bind:group_2} {bind:group_3} past the red line. Let it shut down — you're safe here.
tut.bt.e3.caption: Training safeties are on.
tut.bt.e4.prompt: Hold {bind:override} to force the reactor back online.
tut.bt.e4.caption: In the field, overriding can damage your reactor.
tut.bt.f1.prompt: Build speed with {bind:throttle_up}, then hold {bind:jump} to boost over the barrier.
tut.bt.f1.caption: Boost costs heat — watch the bar.
tut.bt.g1.prompt: Your wing is on the pad. Hold {bind:command_wheel}, select ATTACK MY TARGET, release.
tut.bt.h1.prompt: Checkride: three practice drones inbound. Weapons free — {bind:group_1} {bind:group_2} {bind:group_3}.
tut.bt.h1.caption: Hold {bind:help} for the cheat sheet · hold {bind:skip_step} to skip the checkride.
tut.bt.h2.prompt: Basic training complete. Press {bind:ui_confirm} to return to the menu.
tut.bt.a2.prompt_vo: Lower throttle. Come to a stop.
tut.bt.a4a.prompt_vo: The arrow points your way. Confirm.
tut.bt.a4b.prompt_vo: Face the arrow. Walk to it.
tut.bt.b1.prompt_vo: Twist your torso. Scan both sides.
tut.bt.b2.prompt_vo: Hold your reticle on the board.
tut.bt.b3.prompt_vo: Snap your torso back in line.
tut.bt.b4.prompt_vo: Walk while holding aim on the board.
tut.bt.b5.prompt_vo: Magnify your optics on the far board.
tut.bt.c1.prompt_vo: A contact is up. Lock it.
tut.bt.c2.prompt_vo: Cycle your contacts. Lock all three.
tut.bt.c3.prompt_vo: Select a section of your lock.
tut.bt.c4.prompt_vo: Study the damage readout. Confirm when ready.
tut.bt.d1.prompt_vo: Fire the autocannon at a board.
tut.bt.d4.prompt_vo: Weapons free. Destroy all four boards.
tut.bt.e1.prompt_vo: Fire until heat reaches the amber line.
tut.bt.e3.prompt_vo: Keep firing. Let it shut down.
tut.bt.e4.prompt_vo: Hold override. Bring the reactor back.
tut.bt.f1.prompt_vo: Build speed. Boost over the barrier.
tut.bt.g1.prompt_vo: Command wheel. Order your wing to attack.
tut.bt.g2.prompt_vo: Recall your wing to the pad.
tut.bt.h1.prompt_vo: Checkride. Three drones inbound. Weapons free.
